jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
### **About Forma.ai:**



Forma.ai is a Series B startup that's revolutionizing how sales compensation is designed, managed and optimized. We handle billions in annual managed commissions for market leaders like Edmentum, Stryker, and Autodesk.



Our growth has been fuelled by our passion for fundamentally changing and shaping how companies use sales intelligence to drive business strategy.



We're welcoming equally driven individuals who are excited about creating something big!

**DIRECTOR OF STRATEGIC FINANCE**  

Strategic FP\&A, AI Automation, \& Executive\-Level Storytelling


**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



We are looking for an exceptional, hands\-on Director of Strategic Finance to act as the strategic right\-hand lead to our VP of Finance. Operating alongside our Controller (who leads accounting close, statutory compliance, tax, and ERP administration), you will own our forward\-looking financial strategy. You will lead our corporate modelling, deploy AI and modern automation workflows across Finance and RevOps, execute on M\&A and capital markets transactions, and use generative AI or AI applications to build out high\-performance analytics frameworks as the company scales.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES):**  

  

1\. Hands\-On Strategic FP\&A \& Corporate Modeling  

* Corporate Financial Architecture: Build and maintain our dynamic 3\-statement models, weekly/monthly/quarterly operating plans, revenue forecasting, multi\-year operating forecasts, and scenario analyses from the ground up without relying on junior analysts.
* Executive \& Board Presentation: Spearhead the quantitative financial narrative, analysis, and materials for Board of Directors meetings, executive quarterly reviews, and investor reporting.
* Corporate Planning: Lead the annual budgeting process by working with the executive team to develop an annual plan with near real\-time reporting on plan progress.
* Future Team Foundation: Establish rigorous modeling standards and analytical infrastructure today, with the mandate to hire, mentor, and build out an FP\&A and FinOps team over the next 1–2 years.


2\. Financial Engineering \& AI Workflow Automation  

* AI Agent \& Workflow Deployment: Identify manual bottlenecks across billing, contract parsing, data extraction, and commercial operations; build and deploy LLM workflows, custom prompts, and automated scripts.
* Data Pipeline \& Systems Integration: Architect and optimize data flows connecting CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), CPQ, Billing, and ERP systems to automate revenue operations and eliminate reconciliation friction.
* Modern Automation Tooling: Use tools like Python, SQL, Zapier/Make, and API integrations to establish self\-sustaining, real\-time reporting layers.
* AI Analytics \& Insights: Leverage AI to drive deeper analysis and insights throughout the organization (i.e. QBR's, MMR's, BvA's)


3\. RevOps \& Commercial Structuring  

* GTM Engine Analytics: Partner with RevOps to track and analyze sales capacity, pipeline velocity, CAC/LTV dynamics, and retention cohorts.
* Deal Structuring \& Deal Desk: Serve as the primary strategic finance partner to Sales and RevOps on deal structuring, pricing models, margin analysis, discounting schedules, and commercial contract terms.


4\. **M\&A / Capital Markets Execution \& Compensation Modelling**  

* Transaction \& Valuation Execution: Own the operational execution for M\&A / capital market transactions, including due diligence financial modelling, virtual data room (VDR) setup, and cap table administration
* Compensation Architecture: Model and maintain corporate compensation bands, incentive structures, and equity option pool dilution economics.
  

**WHO YOU ARE (QUALIFICATIONS):**


* 7–10\+ years in Strategic Finance, FP\&A, BizOps, or Investment Banking / Management Consulting followed by high\-growth B2B SaaS operational experience. Strong business acumen with a high intellectual curiosity.
* **FP\&A Mastery:** Spreadsheet wizard with demonstrated mastery of complex revenue modelling, 3\-statement modelling, operational modelling, SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, CAC payback), and executive\-level financial storytelling.
* **Engineering \& AI Mindset:** Practical experience architecting the finance tech stack and working with data, deploying AI/LLM tools, automation platforms (Python, SQL, Zapier/Make), and SaaS toolchains (Salesforce, Stripe/Chargebee, NetSuite) to eliminate manual workflows.
* **Commercial Depth:** Proven deal desk and commercial contract experience, with a solid grasp of pricing models, billing schedules, and equity compensation economics.
* **Autonomy \& Drive:** High\-autonomy builder who thrives with ambiguity and enjoys executing hands\-on work from scratch with the leadership aptitude to manage direct reports as the team grows.

 **WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT:**  

  

You won't be managing month\-end reconciliations, audits, tax filings, or HR administration—our Controller leads those domains with excellence. You are joining to be an operational architect and strategic partner: designing intelligent financial infrastructure, building board\-level models, and leveraging AI to scale our operational engine.

  

**ADDITIONAL JOB INFO:**


* This position is for an existing vacancy
* Salary range: 150\-180K

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------


**Meaningful compensation.** In addition to your base salary, you'll join our employee stock ownership plan to further recognize your contributions to Forma.ai's success.


**Healthcare coverage.** We have a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and a paid parental leave program.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation
jobs.description:
**Location:**

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**


Reporting to the VP, Pharmacy Operations, Clinical Excellence and Transformation, the Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation will lead the strategy and execution of transformational initiatives shaping the future of pharmacy at Shoppers Drug Mart.


This role will own the **pharmacy AI, technology, automation and optimization agenda**, while ensuring that the patient and pharmacy team experience remains at the centre of transformation. The successful candidate will identify and scale opportunities that improve how patients access and experience pharmacy care, simplify pharmacy workflows, enhance team member experience and deliver measurable operational and business value.


Working closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence, and other cross\-functional partners, this leader will translate emerging capabilities, patient and team insights, and business opportunities into a clear transformation strategy and roadmap. They will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, taking initiatives from early\-stage discovery and business case development through implementation, adoption, and scale.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Define and lead the Pharmacy Experience and Transformation strategy and roadmap, with a strong focus on AI, automation, technology and the evolving needs of patients and pharmacy teams.
* Own the pharmacy AI agenda, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve patient experience, pharmacy workflows, team member experience and operational performance.
* Lead a portfolio of key transformation initiatives, including Experience Insights \& Analysis, Pharmacy Experience Program (PEP), Rx Delivery, AI Call Agent and Assisted Data Entry.
* Translate strategic opportunities into scalable solutions, leading initiatives from discovery, concept development and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
* Champion a patient\- and team\-centred approach to transformation, ensuring new technology and process changes make pharmacy interactions simpler, more seamless and more meaningful.
* Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify and automate pharmacy workflows, reducing administrative burden and enabling pharmacy teams to spend more time supporting patients and delivering care.
* Use patient feedback, pharmacy team insights, operational data, market trends and emerging technology to identify opportunities and shape the future pharmacy experience.
* Partner closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence and other teams to align business priorities, technology capabilities and investment against the transformation roadmap.
* Lead experience discovery and analysis to better understand patient and team member pain points, unmet needs and emerging expectations, and translate those insights into actionable transformation priorities.
* Establish clear success measures across patient experience, pharmacy team experience, operational performance and financial value, and monitor outcomes to ensure initiatives are delivering meaningful impact.
* Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity and structure to complex transformation opportunities and driving decisions required to move initiatives forward.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team with a strong culture of strategic thinking, innovation, experimentation, accountability and execution.

 **What You’ll Need**

* Senior leadership experience in strategy, AI, digital transformation, technology, customer experience or large\-scale business transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop transformation strategies and take complex initiatives from concept and business case through implementation and scale.
* Strong understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to improve customer or patient experience, frontline workflows and operational efficiency.
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure and direction to complex or ambiguous opportunities.
* A strong human\-centred mindset, with demonstrated ability to translate patient, customer and frontline team needs into meaningful experience improvements.
* Strong business acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, build compelling business cases and connect transformation investments to measurable value.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives across operations, technology, digital and business teams.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around a transformation agenda.
* Experience using data, insights and performance measures to inform strategy, prioritize opportunities and assess impact.
* Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, technology, consulting or another complex operating environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high\-performing teams through significant change and transformation.
* Post\-Secondary education in Industrial or Process Engineer / Technology / Business/ Healthcare or Operations
* 7\-10 years' experience, retail preferred
* MBA or relevant advanced degree is an asset.
* Must be available

jobs.title: Senior Director, Group Product Owner - Enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance (eGRC)
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

As Senior Director, Group Product Owner – Enterprise Governance, Risk \& Compliance (eGRC), you'll shape how CIBC identifies, manages, and responds to operational risk. You will shift our programs from manual, periodic, judgment\-based activities to connected, AI\-enabled capabilities that anticipate risk, automate routine work, and focus people on the decisions that matter most.


You will lead CIBC's eGRC ecosystem, including the Operational Risk System (ORS) and enterprise operational risk data governance. With a mandate to rethink, not simply maintain, you'll define the target operating model, investment priorities, and product roadmap; simplify and automate risk work with our program team; and use connected data, advanced analytics, generative and agentic AI, and continuous monitoring to surface emerging risk and improve decisions. You will ensure these capabilities are deployed responsibly through strong data, model, security, privacy, control, and human\-in\-the\-loop practices.

  

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

* **Enterprise Strategy and Transformation** \- Define the ambition, target operating model, and multi\-year roadmap for CIBC's eGRC ecosystem. Align partners and investment to the highest risk and regulatory priorities, making bold, evidence\-based choices that create lasting value.
* **Enterprise Product Leadership** \- Set priorities from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. Establish disciplined governance, translate strategy into a clear roadmap, and use customer, risk, operational, and financial insight to accelerate outcomes and demonstrate value.
* **Reimagining Operational Risk Programs** \- Redesign core programs, including risk and control assessments, control management, issues, incidents, losses, scenarios, regulatory change, and reporting. Replace fragmented manual processes with simpler, automated, connected experiences that improve coverage, reduce administration, and focus attention on the highest\-risk exposures and actions.
* **AI, Automation and Insight\-Driven Risk** \- Make operational risk data a trusted enterprise asset across eGRC and ORS. Set standards for ownership, quality, lineage, access, retention, and traceability; automate workflows, evidence gathering, monitoring, and reporting; and apply analytics and responsible AI to detect patterns, anticipate risk, and recommend action. Measure success through stronger outcomes, earlier intervention, better user experience, and capacity shifted from administration to judgment.
* **Executive Governance and Regulatory Confidence** \- Establish clear decision rights, accountability, and portfolio oversight. Influence senior forums with concise, forward\-looking recommendations, and keep the ecosystem resilient and ready for regulatory and audit scrutiny.
* **Enterprise Influence and Coalition Building** \- Unite Business, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Resilience, Third\-Party, Technology, Data, and Architecture around a shared vision. Resolve trade\-offs and build the executive sponsorship and cross\-functional ownership needed for enterprise change.
* Investment, Delivery and Strategic Partnerships \- Turn ambition into an executable portfolio by aligning funding, capacity, sequencing, and risk to the highest\-value outcomes. Drive performance, innovation, and measurable value while keeping eGRC and ORS stable, secure, and fit for purpose.
* **Leadership and Capability Building** \- Build a high\-performing team with the product, risk, data, and transformation capabilities to lead at enterprise scale. Create clarity, empower decisions, and foster curiosity, courage, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Oversee the eGRC helpdesk to maintain responsive support and turn recurring pain points into improvements.
  

  

**Who you are**

  

* **You're an enterprise transformation leader** with 10\+ years of progressive leadership across risk, compliance, controls, technology, product, or related disciplines, and a record of delivering complex change in a regulated organization.
* **You bring deep operational risk judgment** . You understand how frameworks, assessments, controls, issues, losses, data, and regulatory expectations connect, and translate that expertise into practical choices without unnecessary complexity.
* **You champion trusted data and high\-performing partnerships** . You have established data ownership, standards, quality, lineage, and remediation practices, and can challenge and inspire strategic technology vendors to improve performance, innovation, risk management, and value.
* **You're a visionary** , customer\-focused product leader who reimagines risk programs through AI, automation, data, and human\-centred design. You turn complex user, business, and regulatory needs into a clear roadmap and align stakeholders around measurable outcomes.
* **You have a record of delivering transformation at scale** , leading multi\-year initiatives from business case and design through implementation, integration, operating model change, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable results.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**



SickKids Foundation, with over 50 years of philanthropic impact is Canada's largest charitable funder of child health research, learning and care, raising over $200 million last year. As a national charity, SickKids Foundation invests in national and international initiatives to benefit children in Canada and around the world. As the fundraising partner to The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), we are aligned in supporting Precision Child Health (PCH), the future of tailoring medicine to each child's unique traits so SickKids can diagnose faster, treat smarter, and predict better.



We are driven by our core values of integrity, collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, with goals of delivering a superior donor experience, investing in our people and culture, driving innovative and sustainable fundraising, and disrupting the market through data and technology.



SickKids Foundation is committed to an inclusive culture by embedding equity, diversity and inclusion in our policies, practices, and behaviours. We aim to build awareness and skills in this area, both internally and with our partners. Our commitment extends to creating a safe, positive work environment. For details on our Equity, Diversity \& Inclusion commitment, please click here. (https://www.sickkidsfoundation.com/aboutus/equitydiversityandinclusion)



We’re committed to attracting and retaining passionate individuals to help create a healthier future. That’s why SickKids Foundation is looking for a new Associate Director, Data Engineer.


**Description of the Position**



Reporting to the Director, Data Science \& Engineering, the Associate Director, Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates enterprise\-grade data platforms that deliver trusted, well\-governed data across SickKids Foundation. The role will help establish and evolve a production\-grade cloud platform using medallion architecture principles, with a focus on reliability, data quality, cost efficiency, and scalable delivery.



As a senior hands\-on technical contributor, you will set engineering standards, support platform incident response, enable self\-serve analytics and AI\-powered data products, and provide specialized technical guidance to data and analytics partners across the Foundation.


**You will**


* Design, build, and operate enterprise\-grade data engineering platforms using modern cloud technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks, aligned to bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture principles.
* Build and maintain robust, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines with embedded validation, data quality checks, clear lineage, and repeatable delivery workflows.
* Design data models and semantic layers that make trusted data accessible for analytics, reporting, and self\-serve business intelligence.
* Establish platform observability through query profiling, cost attribution, utilization metrics, alerting, and SLO/SLA monitoring; lead day\-to\-day response to data availability and performance incidents.
* Define and enforce coding standards, CI/CD patterns, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices to support consistent, secure, and scalable platform deployment.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Data \& Analytics, IT/Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate requirements into reliable platform capabilities and support appropriate access, governance, and compliance.
* Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases, including natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products, by partnering with stakeholders to identify and deliver high\-value opportunities.
* Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, AI, and emerging engineering practices, bringing relevant advancements into the platform roadmap and providing technical guidance to analysts, BI developers, and engineering partners.


**Qualifications**



While we know that for any job posting no one candidate will possess the qualifications being sought in equal measure, below is an outline of the qualifications we believe are important for a candidate to bring to the position or for the successful candidate to develop while in the role:


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on data engineering or platform engineering experience, ideally spanning the full lifecycle of architecting, building, and operating production data platforms.
* Deep technical expertise with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks and strong knowledge of medallion/lakehouse architecture.
* Strong data modelling and database design skills for analytics and business consumption, including dimensional modelling and semantic layers for self\-serve BI.
* Hands\-on experience developing production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data quality, governance, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Experience establishing observability, performance monitoring, reliability standards, and incident\-response practices in production data environments.
* Working knowledge of AI and advanced analytics tooling, including approaches that support natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products.
* Strong technical judgment, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholder groups.
* Knowledge of foundational data domains, business processes, and enterprise applications is an asset.


We’re looking for a passionate individual who is interested in moving the dial and making a difference. We are an environment that looks to attract hardworking and committed people; people who want to challenge themselves and grow with a globally recognized brand that continues to change the world. If this describes you, consider joining our team. We look forward to reviewing your application.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Execution
jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

**The Work**
------------



The Senior Director, Enterprise Execution is responsible for helping EQB translate strategic priorities into business outcomes.



Working directly with executive leaders across the organization, this role leads a focused portfolio of the Bank's most important enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities. These are high\-impact, cross\-functional efforts that are critical to delivering EQB's strategy, growth ambitions, and financial objectives. The role serves as a bridge between strategy, execution, and outcomes, ensuring that the Bank's biggest priorities maintain momentum, overcome obstacles, and deliver the impact they were intended to achieve.



Enterprise Execution acts as an execution partner to leadership, bringing structured problem\-solving, strategic thinking, and execution discipline to a select group of enterprise priorities. The role combines elements of strategy execution, enterprise leadership, organizational effectiveness, and executive problem\-solving, helping translate strategic ambition into measurable results.



The ideal candidate combines the structured problem\-solving capabilities of a top\-tier strategy consultant with the practical execution mindset of an experienced operator. They are highly comfortable working in ambiguous situations, quickly building credibility with senior stakeholders, and driving progress on complex challenges that cut across multiple business units. They are intellectually curious, commercially minded, and action\-oriented. They know how to move seamlessly between strategy and execution, challenge and support, analysis and action. Most importantly, they have a demonstrated ability to help organizations deliver on their most important priorities and achieve meaningful outcomes.



### **Strategic Initiative Leadership \& Enterprise Priorities (55%)**


* Lead a portfolio of EQB's highest\-priority enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities, including CEO\- and CFO\-sponsored programs.
* Partner directly with executive sponsors and act as a trusted advisor to mobilize, accelerate, and deliver initiatives that are critical to achieving the Bank's strategic and financial objectives.
* Provide hands\-on leadership for complex cross\-functional initiatives requiring enterprise coordination, senior stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Shape implementation approaches, execution strategies, operating models, and delivery plans to maximize organizational impact.
* Challenge assumptions, strengthen plans, and improve decision\-making through structured problem solving and rigorous analysis.
* Identify and resolve issues, risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers that could impede successful execution.
* Bring an enterprise\-wide perspective that helps ensure initiatives advance broader corporate objectives.
### **Strategic Execution \& Outcome Realization (25%)**


* Ensure approved business cases and strategic objectives translate into measurable business, customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
* Partner with initiative leaders to strengthen execution plans and improve the likelihood of successful outcomes.
* Identify emerging risks, dependencies, and barriers requiring intervention and help drive resolution.
* Provide executive visibility into initiative progress, key decisions, and areas requiring leadership attention.
* Work closely with Finance, initiative owners, and business leaders to understand expected versus realized outcomes and identify opportunities to improve performance.
* Conduct initiative reviews and post\-implementation assessments to reinforce accountability and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of disciplined execution and ownership across enterprise priorities.
### **Enterprise Planning \& Prioritization (10%)**


* Lead the annual enterprise initiative prioritization process as part of EQB's strategic planning cycle.
* Partner with business leaders, Finance, and Strategy teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize initiatives requiring investment and organizational capacity.
* Facilitate discussions regarding sequencing, trade\-offs, resource allocation, and execution readiness.
* Develop an integrated view of enterprise priorities, dependencies, and investment requirements to support executive decision\-making.
* Help ensure organizational focus remains concentrated on initiatives that create the greatest strategic impact.
### **Executive \& Board Effectiveness (10%)**


* Help ensure EQB's most important strategic priorities, enterprise initiatives, and investment decisions are supported by clear, aligned, and decision\-ready executive and Board materials.
* Partner with senior leaders across the organization to elevate the quality, consistency, and strategic coherence of materials presented to Executive Leadership Team and Board forums.
* Ensure major strategic discussions are informed by a cohesive enterprise perspective and supported by fact\-based, well\-structured recommendations.
* Challenge gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and disconnects across strategic updates, investment proposals, and enterprise initiatives before they reach decision\-making forums.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

jobs.title: Canada Technology Consulting - Business Platform Transformation Senior Director
jobs.description:
**JOB REQUISITION**

Canada Technology Consulting \- Business Platform Transformation Senior Director
**LOCATION**

VANCOUVER
**ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**You Belong Here**

The Protiviti Career provides an opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.


At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.  



  

  

**Where We Need You:**

The Technology Consulting Practice is seeking a Senior Director to join our growing team and lead client transformation across the Quote to Cash ecosystem, including Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), billing, order management, revenue recognition, and broader revenue operations transformation. Quote to Cash has become the operational backbone of modern revenue models, requiring organizations to connect commercial strategy, technology architecture, process design, data integrity, and delivery excellence. Subscription pricing, usage\-based billing, complex contracting, and AI\-accelerated deal cycles require a leader who can help clients modernize how revenue is designed, sold, contracted, billed, recognized, and optimized.  



  

  

**What You Can Expect:**

This is a practice\-building leadership role with responsibility for advancing the firm’s Quote to Cash transformation capabilities across market positioning, client advisory, technology partner alignment, delivery methodology, talent development, and commercial and delivery performance. The Senior Director will help define how the firm goes to market, how client transformation engagements are shaped and delivered, which technology partners are prioritized, and how the practice creates measurable value for clients across the Q2C ecosystem.  



  

  

**What Will Help You Be Successful:**

* Define and evolve the firm’s Q2C practice vision, service portfolio, go\-to\-market strategy, priority client segments, and market differentiation.
* Originate and support client opportunities in partnership with sales leadership, including serving as the senior SME in pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and executive client conversations.
* Build the firm’s market presence through thought leadership, speaking opportunities, webinars, analyst relationships, and other external visibility channels.
* Lead or sponsor the most complex Q2C advisory and implementation engagements, providing credible executive guidance across business process, architecture, platform selection, integration, and post\-go\-live optimization.
* Design scalable Q2C operating models across CPQ, contract lifecycle, recurring and usage\-based billing, order management, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, data, and analytics.
* Establish and maintain strategic alliances with key technology partners, including Salesforce, Zuora, Oracle, Stripe, Logi Sense, Conga, Docusign, and other Q2C ecosystem providers.
* Create and standardize delivery methodology, frameworks, assessment tools, accelerators, reference architectures, and reusable assets that improve quality, consistency, and practitioner leverage.

jobs.description:
**Toronto Pearson is transforming. Now’s the time for your career to fly.**



The Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) is a unique and dynamic place to work, with a bold plan to make Toronto Pearson, Canada’s leading global hub airport, a global leader in airport performance, customer care and sustainability. Together with our partners, approximately 2,100 GTAA employees are working to create a next\-generation airport by innovating in all we do and striving for the most uplifting, safe and efficient experience for our passengers – all while championing the prosperity of our people, the community we call home, and our aviation partners. Join us on our journey together, as we put the joy back into travel and make Toronto Pearson the chosen place to fly and work.


**What's in it for you?**


* An opportunity to grow, develop, and thrive within a dynamic, and fast\-growing company alongside thoughtful and passionate individuals dedicated to their work and community.
* Comprehensive benefits, including a flexible retirement program with employer matching, along with voluntary savings options (RRSP, TFSA, and Non\-Registered Savings Plans).
* A flexible hybrid work environment, continuous internal and external learning opportunities, and a meaningful reward and recognition program.


**What can you expect from this position?**



Reporting to the Executive Director, Capital Planning, the Associate Director, Capital Investment Strategy will lead the Capital Investments function and help determine where and why Toronto Pearson invests. You will provide financial leadership across the front end of the capital investment lifecycle by supporting strategic initiative business cases, portfolio prioritization, project intake, investment governance, and benefits realization. Working with business units, the Transformation Office, Strategy, Finance business partners, and program teams, you will translate strategic priorities into decision\-ready investment recommendations for executive consideration. You will establish consistent methodologies, standards, and controls so that capital investments are strategically aligned, financially sound, affordable, and supported by reliable data and robust business intelligence.


**As an Associate Director, Capital Investment Strategy, you will:**


* Lead the development and financial evaluation of business cases for major strategic initiatives, while establishing the standards and methodologies applied across the broader capital portfolio.
* Develop complex financial models incorporating NPV, IRR, ROIC, cash flow, sensitivity, scenario, and risk\-adjusted investment analyses.
* Challenge assumptions and translate complex analysis into decision\-ready recommendations for executive and Board\-level consideration.
* Lead quarterly financial forecasting and reporting for multi\-year strategic initiatives.
* Support the enterprise capital allocation and prioritization process with a multidisciplinary team, applying consistent strategic, financial, affordability, risk, and delivery\-capacity criteria to recommend investments, sequencing decisions, trade\-offs, and off\-ramp actions to executive governance forums.
* Establish and maintain enterprise investment\-governance standards, including business\-case methodologies and templates, evaluation criteria, capital allocation frameworks, hurdle rates, risk premiums, stage\-gate requirements, and decision records that support consistent and transparent recommendations.
* Lead the enterprise project intake and triage process partnering with the appropriate teams to confirm strategic alignment, scope maturity, resource capacity, accounting treatment, funding pathway, and business\-case requirements before investments advance for prioritization or approval.
* Establish benefits and cost baselines for approved investments, integrate expected outcomes into portfolio planning, monitor realization across all programs, and lead post\-investment evaluations that identify variances, lessons learned, and implications for future capital allocation decisions.
* Support the evaluation of public\-private partnerships and alternative delivery models, including financial returns, affordability, financing approaches, and risk allocation.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team while fostering accountability, collaboration, analytical excellence, and continuous improvement.


**This is the role for you, if you have:**

* A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* A CPA, CFA, CBV, MBA, or other relevant professional designation or graduate degree is considered an asset.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in investment analysis, corporate finance, infrastructure finance, business\-case development, portfolio planning, or major capital programs, including experience leading complex, cross\-functional investment decisions in a leadership capacity.
* Advanced expertise in financial modelling, scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, and investment evaluation methodologies.
* Expertise in developing decision\-ready business cases for major strategic or capital initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing or operating capital allocation, project intake, stage\-gate, investment\-governance, or benefits\-realization processes across a complex portfolio.
* Experience evaluating public\-private partnerships or alternative capital\-project delivery and financing models.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across senior leadership and business functions.
* Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear business implications and recommendations.
* Strategic thinking, sound judgement, and strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing finance professionals in a collaborative environment.
